ENDORSE
CHIP IN
#### Coming soon!
#### MEET JAMES
#### ISSUES
#### ENDORSEMENTS
#### COUNCIL PAGE
# A VISION FOR SAN LEANDRO
# San Leandro leaders should work for you,
never against you.
#### "
#### WHAT IF ________
# We had a plan for revitalizing & transforming District 2?
#### WHAT IF ________
# We took a smarter, creative approach to the issues?
# San Leandro can't thrive if we keep voting for politics as ususal.
# We need leadership you can rely on, where you are at the center.
#### "
#### HI! IM JAMES AGUILAR
#### My journey starts in Oakland, where I grew up with mom and dad - union workers for Safeway #805, UFCW Local 5. After living under a landlord who refused to address an issue that impacted my mom's health, my family looked to San Leandro for a new beginning.
Since then, I have lived in San Leandro for over thirteen years, and in that thirteen years I graduated from San Lorenzo High School, got my BA in Political Science from SF State, and Master of Education from National University. I was elected to the San Leandro School Board in 2018, and subsequently built my professional career around public education. I came back to my high school to teach Social Science and become the Activities Director, and also took up roles up and down the nonprofit ladder.
I am incredibly honored to have served our beautiful city in so many ways, and now on the City Council representing District 2. I love our city so much. San Leandro made me who I am, and is a unique place to work together, build together, and thrive together. I'm here to stay. I work for you.
Your support on November 3rd would mean the world to me. Let's work together.
#### Seven years ago, I stepped on to the San Leandro School Board and now proudly represent you on the City Council. If you're interested in a detailed account of what I've been up to on the City Council, check out my monthly updates on Substack by clicking here.
#### What will I continue doing as your Councilmember?
#### Improve the Quality of Life in San Leandro
#### ON THE BIG ISSUES
#### WORK TOGETHER ★ BUILD TOGETHER ★ THRIVE TOGETHER
#### The City Budget is not in a great place. And, while we have done work on Council to address some of the challenges of a major deficit and unfunded capital projects and pension liabilities - we need to do more. I will continue to...
#### Bring realistic solutions to generating revenue including supporting programs for children and families, and brining business to our city.
#### Build partnerships with local organizations and nonprofits with resources we need.
#### Make hard decisions on budget reduction measures with empathy and realism✅
#### ​
#### Qualifications: City Council, Nonprofit Executive Vice President and Audit Chair, CSBA Audit Committee, San Leandro School Board
#### THE BUDGET. PRIORITY #1
#### For so many generations in San Leandro politics, District 2 (east side of town) has been left out. It is time for that to change, and with me at the table I will continue to...
#### Work with developers of the Bayfair property✅
#### Explore the creation of a Cultural Arts District, similar to that of the Downtown CBD.
#### Explore long term strategy for creating a community center on our side of town.
#### Work to​ attract business to vacant District 2 properties with effective policy changes.
#### Advocate for the repair of all District 2 roads.
#### ​
#### Qualifications: City Council, Council Facilities and Transportation Committee, San Leandro School Board, Legislative Advocacy Efforts
#### DISTRICT 2 AT THE TABLE
#### The Climate Crisis is no laughing matter, and it has come early to San Leandro -- coastline degradation, lack of accountability to address climate action. I will continue to...
#### Be a vocal advocate in upholding the city's commitment to the Climate Action Plan✅
#### Work with local organizations like SL 2050 in acquiring grants, and acquiring climate data (via Aclima, et. al) to make informed decisions related to projects with an effect on San Leandro's air quality and environmental impact.​
#### Work to ban data centers in San Leandro.
#### ​
#### Qualifications: City Council, San Leandro 2050 Steering Committee and Senior Director, Nonprofit Environmental Policy Coordinator
#### RESPONSE TO CLIMATE CRISIS
#### What if it was easier and more affordable to live in San Leandro? It would mean San Leandro residents stay, and our community thrives. We need more housing and solutions for our unhoused population. I will continue to...
#### Partner with county, state, and nonprofit organizations to collaborate on resource building and developing safety nets.
#### Support and maintain existing Rent Stabilization ordinance✅ including administration of the Rent Registry.
#### Address the issue of housing supply.
#### ​
#### Qualifications: City Council, Council Facilities and Transportation Committee, Legislative Advocacy Efforts
#### HOUSING, THE ISSUE OF OUR TIME
#### San Leandro's success is built on the business community's back. I'm grateful to have the opportunity to build partnerships with large and small business alike. I will continue to...
#### Build relationships with the Chamber of Commerce and business community.
#### Engage in regular comms with the Chamber of Commerce and business community.
#### Strengthen communication network between the City and all San Leandro businesses.
#### Spur ​economic development by ensuring new businesses have room to grow as they enter our city (i.e., incentives, physical support).
#### ​
#### Qualifications: City Council, Nonprofit Executive Roles
#### BUSINESSES, THE BACKBONE
#### Public safety is on the mind of so many San Leandro residents. The reality is that people feel unsafe, and equally that they face a department with structural issues. I will continue to...
#### Fight for increasing capacity and patrol staff at San Leandro Police Department.
#### Work with SLPD and City Council to develop plans for alternate community-centered response to calls.
#### Increase emergency response time throughout the entire city.
#### Hold SLPD accountable.
#### ​
#### Qualifications: City Council, Collaboration with Alameda County Sheriff's Office, Legislative Advocacy Efforts
#### OVERHAULING PUBLIC SAFETY
#### It's no secret that the City Council still has work to do to rebuild trust with San Leandro residents among infighting and federal indictments. I will continue to...
#### Advocate for a City Council self evaluation mechanism similar to the School Board✅
#### Be a vocal advocate on the Council for governance best practices.
#### Communicate with residents about progress regularly and consistently✅
#### Strengthen and ground the relationship of the Council as a governing body, moving us toward consensus model leadership and stewardship.
#### ​
#### Qualifications: City Council, San Leandro School Board, Nonprofit Executive Roles
#### COUNCIL GOVERNANCE
#### Even in my years on the School Board, we struggled to 'define' the relationship between City staff and School District staff. Let's do that. We need authentic engagement and collaboration with our school district partners. I will continue to...
#### Work with the School District Governing Board, Superintendent, and staff to literally develop a working definition of city/school relations.
#### Collaborate with School Board members frequently and consistently.
#### Fund projects to support school operations, and partnership with city parks✅
#### ​
#### Qualifications: San Leandro School Board, City Council, California School Boards Association, High School Teacher, Master of Education
#### SUPPORTING OUR SCHOOLS
#### What have I done as your Councilmember?
#### Teamwork and Progressive Policy
#### ON THE CITY DAIS
#### ★ BECAUSE SAN LEANDRO DESERVES CARE ★
#### I am proud to call the Council a team -- that's what we are, that's my expectation. Together, while I have served, we have done much to push the City of San Leandro forward despite some roadblocks in our way.​​
#### Consistent communication with San Leandro community via Substack monthly updates.
#### Built authentic relationships with each Councilmember, because they're human, too.
#### Voted to direct staff to remove rent increase/decrease fees under the rent stabilization ordinance.
#### Voted to change San Leandro's default energy provider to lower costs for San Leandro residents.
#### Voted to direct staff to ensure the San Leandro business community is respected with intentional collaboration has time to collaborate on developing a modernized Business License Tax.
#### Supported staff in including AC Transit in the conversation around the Bayfair development.
#### Voted on the transition plan to Workday, increasing cross-department and clerical efficiency.
#### Voted on a data integration platform for SLPD to move past physical documenting, increasing efficiency.
#### AT WORK SINCE DAY 1. TRACKING THE ACTIONS:
